How to get it :
- Crafting table : 6 x [[gv:nugget_uranium_fuel|Nugget of Uranium Fuel]].
- Crafting table (x3) : 2 x [[gv:ingot_uranium_fuel|Ingot of Uranium Fuel]].
- Crafting table (x6) : 5 x [[Uranium-238|Uranium-238 Billet]], [[Uranium-235|Uranium-235 Billet]].
(1 more recipes: see JEI.)

Used to make :
[[gv:billet_mox_fuel|MOX Fuel Billet]], [[Uranium|Uranium Billet]], [[gv:ingot_uranium_fuel|Ingot of Uranium Fuel]], [[gv:nugget_uranium_fuel|Nugget of Uranium Fuel]], [[gv:billet_uzh|Uranium Zirconium Hydride Billet]], [[gv:pwr_fuel_meu|MEU PWR Fuel Rod]], [[gv:rbmk_fuel_meu|MEU RBMK Fuel Rod]].
